notes.title: Preview: Tree of Savior Zachariel Release and Integration of Region
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/b2b0588317b3671e1cca98ab778b98a37dd12f9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Saviors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]To bring new encounters and expanded adventures to Tree of Savior, the current servers: [b]NA[/b] Klaipeda, [b]EU[/b] Fedimian, and [b]SA[/b] Silute will be [b]merged into a single server[/b] named ‘[b]Zachariel[/b]’ on [b]Tuesday, July 15, 2025 (KST).[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The new [b]Zachariel [/b]server will unite Saviors from various regions, forming a diverse community that transcends language and culture. We believe this significant change will inject vitality into the game, fostering more dynamic strategies and collaboration in an enriched gameplay environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Saviors from your favorite guilds and regions will be able to find new goals to work towards, while those who aren't tied to a guild or region will be able to create their own unique groupings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]No new installations or changes are required to access Zachariel Server[/b]. Simply launch the Tree of Savior client through Steam as usual, and you will automatically connect to the merged server.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️I[u]n the meanwhile, SA Silute TP Product Sales will be restricted due to this Server Merge[/u]⚠️ [/b][/p][p]
TP product sales in the SA server will be temporarily restricted starting from the date of this announcement. This is due to price standardization to align with NA/EU server pricing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/e9da67cc957c47d01f4acb21366bbe80fb40df74.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of [b]Zachariel[/b], we have prepared a variety of exciting events for all Saviors.[/p][p]In particular,[b] special rewards[/b] will be awarded for the [b]first Guild Territory War[/b] after the integration.[/p][p][/p][p]The first[b] Guild Territory Wars (GTW)[/b] held in the [b]Zachariel[/b] server will offer special rewards. Guilds that occupy the Champion League regions —  'Genar Field', 'Aqueduct Bridge Area', and 'Baron Allerno'— will receive a commemorative guild flag engraved with a text and image of the guild’s choice. [/p][p]Additionally, amazing login rewards will be distributed to all players who log into the [b]Zachariel [/b]server within the first[b] 7 days [/b]after the merge.[/p][p]
             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/1360aa9a9ac015adf9539495a7629c00671584a1.png"][/img]                 [/p][p]We’ve also prepared refreshing[b] summer events[/b] and [b]adorable new mounts[/b] to accompany your journey. We look forward to seeing your exciting adventures unfold in the new [b]Zachariel [/b]server.[/p][p][/p][p]※ The details of the event will be notified in the future announcement.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Zachariel [/b]integrations are guided by the following policies:[/p][p][/p][h2]Tree of Savior Global Merge Policy[/h2][p][/p][p] -  Date: Scheduled maintenance on [b]July 15, 2025 [/b][/p][p] -  Target: [b]NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute[/b][/p][p] -  Server Name: [b]North America Zachariel[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Category[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Major Integration Policies[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you only have a team on 1 server[/p][/td][td][p] # The team is transferred without changes except for the reset categories[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you have teams on more than one server[/p][/td][td][p][b] # Only the information from one team, selected based on the criteria below, will be transferred, and no other team's information will be transferred. (The following criteria will be applied to determine which teams are transferred)[/b]
  1. Team with more premium TPs
  2. Team with higher team levels (experience)
  3. Team with more characters created
  4. Team with later team creation dates

[b] # Premium TPs are transferred to the final team after all teams' information is summed.[/b]
 - They are also transferred if they were converted to points using TP-packaged items.

[b] # For further activation of teams not selected by the above criteria, you will need to apply by creating a new STEAM account.[/b]
 - The details of the procedure will be announced in a separate announcement in the future.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Guild [/p][/td][td][p] [b]# General Guild[/b]
 - If the Guild Master's team is transferred, the guild will also be transferred and any guild members not transferred will be removed from the guild.
 - If the Guild Master's team is not transferred, the guild will be disbanded and the guild members will be changed to a guildless status.
 - If there are two guilds with the same guild name, the later created guild will be renamed to "Guildname_1" and will receive a “Guild Name Change Voucher”.

[b] # TOS Support Guild[/b]
 - If your team is a member of a TOS Support Guild, it will be transferred to the TOS Support Guild on the [b]\[NA] Klaipeda[/b] server.
 - The Guild Master/general guild member's rank and privileges are retained.

[b] # Not in a guild[/b]
 - If the team being transferred is not in a guild, it will be transferred as a guildless status.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [b]※  Premium TPs are paid products, excluding free/event TPs.[/b][/p][p][b] ※  Data related to teams/characters/companions [u]deleted before the integration will be unrecoverable after the integration.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Reset Categories[/h2][h2][/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Category[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Details[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ranking (Record)[/p][/td][td][p][b] # GTW Spot Capture Guilds[/b]
[/p][p][b] # Ranking/Records of the following contents[/b]
 - Blockade Battle, Joint Strike Raid, Weekly Boss Raid, Remnants of Bernice, Fishing, etc[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Guild[/p][/td][td][p][b] # Guilds that do not meet the integration conditions
 [/b][/p][p][b]# GTW tariff, Applications, Guild Tower, Declare War, etc[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Other[/p][/td][td][p][b] # If you have a duplicate team name[/b]
 - The team name of the first team to claim it is retained
 - However, even if the team name is claimed first, if the account hasn't been accessed within one year at the time of the integration, the team name of the other team with the access record will be retained.
 - If all teams have not accessed within a year, the first team to do so keeps the team name.
 - Other teams that don't keep their team name will be renamed to "Team name_1" and will be given a “Team Name Change Voucher”.[/p][p]
[b] # Items listed for sale in the market[/b]
 - These items will be unregistered and moved to your Market Retrieve Tab.
[/p][p][b] # Installed User Shops[/b]
 - All installed user shops such as Food Table, Repair Shop, Spell Shop, and Equipment Maintenance Shop will be removed

notes.title: Help us reduce issues with claiming TP Bundles!
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors,

We would like to announce that we will be offering 20% additional TP as compensation for any players who may have issues with claiming their TP Bundle purchases made from now until April 30th.

The following list shows how much TP you will be compensated with if you have an issue with a certain TP Bundle product.

- Per 100 TP Bundle (100 TP) : Compensation of 20 TP

- Per 300 TP Bundle (310 TP) : Compensation of 70 TP

- Per 500 TP Bundle (530 TP) : Compensation of 110 TP

- Per 900 TP Bundle (990 TP) : Compensation of 200 TP

IMPORTANT : Please read the following conditions to see if you are applicable for compensation.

1-1. You must have either pressed the 'USE' button OR used the '/retrieveAllItems' command in order to start the TP claiming process.

1-2. Any attempts at claiming TP Bundles not meant for your server region will not be counted.

2. A minimum of 24 hours must have passed after the initial start of the TP claiming process (Condition 1-1).

3. You must send us a Ticket via the [url=https://treeofsavior.com/inquiry/]Support Page[/url] when the issue arises.

4. Any attempts at abusing the system may result in you becoming inapplicable for compensation.

 
Thank you as always for the continued love, support, and attention.
 

Best regards,

IMC Staff

notes.title: [UPDATE] Regarding Latest Mission Boss Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We’ve been receiving reports of a couple of issues that have recently started affecting missions in the game. Boss monsters have been known to drop no silver or cubes, and show no ranking after being defeated. 

We would like to let you know that we are aware of these issues and currently working to get them fixed as soon as possible.

We will ask you to kindly report any problems you encounter with a ticket via our Support page. Please provide any details possible regarding what mission/dungeon you played, whether your party was auto-matched or premade, and any other useful details. 

There is a possibility that these errors are caused by large level gaps within members of the same party, so please include your character level and your party members’ as well when you submit your report.

Thank you.

[b]UPDATE[/b]: Please make sure that your revision number in the 'release.revision.txt' file in the following folder (Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release) is number 139117.

If this is not the number you see on the file, it means your current patch is incomplete. Please try verifying game file integrity on Steam or redownloading the patch.

notes.title: [Guild Delete Exploit] Now Accepting Guild Restore Requests
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We recently fixed an exploit in the game that allowed players to disband their guilds without becoming the guild master (more details here). As a result, several guilds have reportedly been deleted unintentionally.

We are planning to restore all guilds disbanded through this exploit during our next scheduled maintenance on May 24, 2016, and will now start accepting requests via Support ticket.

Guild masters of guilds affected by the exploit may send in their requests via Support ticket (Type: Etc) until [b][EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM[/b].

Before you send in your request, make sure you read and understand the conditions below:

- Only guild masters may submit a restore request for their guild
- Requests must be submitted via Support ticket (Type: Etc)
- We will accept requests submitted until [EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM

How to submit your request via Support ticket (only submit if you are the guild master):

1) Go to the Support Page on our official website
2) If you haven't, verify your Steam account
3) Click on Submit Ticket
4) Select Type: Etc, then enter your information on the fields shown
5) Enter the following in Title: -GUILD RESTORE- YOUR GUILD NAME
6) In Description, enter the following information
   - Server:
   - Guild name:
   - Guild master character's name:
   - Approx. date and time guild was deleted (EDT):

Let us know if you run into trouble when submitting your request.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

Finally, should the number of players in another server justify it, we will consider opening more servers in the relevant regions, so make sure to keep an eye out for any future announcements regarding these and other updates.

Sincerely,

notes.title: [UPDATE][Complete] Scheduled Maintenance & Patch Notes - April 12th, 2016
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors!

As previously announced, the servers will be undergoing some maintenance and we would like to let you know what is to be patched during the maintenance period. We also wish to apologize and compensate for the recent issue where users were unable to access dungeons through the party matchmaking system.


[b]Maintenance Period[/b] : 01:00~06:00 AM (EDT) April 12th, 2016

[b]Patch Notes :[/b]
[list]
 [*]You will now be able to access the Ausrine Goddess Statue in the city of Orsha.

 [*]Collection: Ashaq Underground Prison 2F will now function as intended.

 [*]Item distribution will now function properly in parties.

 [*]We've added the option to turn off/on screen shake under "Game Settings."

 [*]We reduced the number of channels in lower level maps while increasing them in higher level maps.

 [*]The issue of monster gem's status changes not being displayed upon equipment has been fixed.

 [*]2nd Demon Prison mob: Key Thief's level has been adjusted properly (194 to 164)

 [*]Kabbalist's skill Gematria: The client will no longer crash when using the skill.

 [*]You can now enter Vera and Igti Coasts without getting the message "This channel is full."

 [*]You can now report bots in-game. If you suspect a user is botting, report them to us by right-clicking on them and selecting [Report bot]. We'll investigate the reported users and block them accordingly.
[/list]

Please note that we are still working on some of the more major tweaks and will patch them as soon as possible.

Thank you for all your patience and understanding. We will strive to provide a service that is worthy of your enthusiasm and support.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff


[UPDATE]
We are aware that some players are experiencing problems patching and launching the game at the moment. We are looking into the issue, but in the meantime here is the workaround. Apologies for the inconvenience.

 - Go to [i][b]Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release[/b][/i]
 - Open the [i][b]release.revision.txt[/b][/i] file and edit the number to [i][b]11460[/b][/i]
 - Validate local files through Steam and check to see if the language is set to English.

notes.title: Regarding Server Log-in Issues [UPDATED - March 30th]
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors!

We are aware that it is taking a while to log onto servers from the server list screen. This issue is caused be a few reasons which we have listed below.

- Excessive clicking of the 'Enter' button by eager Saviors

- GM messages containing Unstable Service Compensation being sent at the same time

This situation will be sorted out eventually as the GM messages are processed. We would like to ask of you to click the 'Enter' button only once as clicking it repeatedly sends multiple requests to the servers increasing the waiting period.

Once again, we ask for your understanding and cooperation with this issue.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

[UPDATE - March 30th]
- The GM messages have been dealt with and the log-in process should be shortened. 

- Due to an explosive growth in player population that exceeded our expectations, we are having internal discussion on how to mitigate the log-in related issues. An official announcement will be made when a final decision is made.

notes.title: Known Issues [UPDATED - April 12th]
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We are aware of the problems some of you are experiencing while trying to log into the game. For the following known issues, please try the solutions we suggest. Head to our official forums for the xml files in question. 

Link to post in official forums : https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/known-issues-march-29th/157442

[b]1. Server List Not Showing on Log-In Screen[/b]

Please download the files from the official forums and copy and paste them to the following directories.

client.xml -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release

updater.config.xml  -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch

updater.config_en.xml 
-> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch


[b]2. $No Data$ texts in-game[/b]

For players that see $No Data$ texts in-game instead of normal text, please try the following.

a) Go to Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release
b) Open release.revision.txt
c) Erase the number that is typed in the file
d) Save the file and close it
e) Restart the game

[b]3. Unable to advance in class[/b]

We are aware that some of you are experiencing problems when trying to advance in class. The dev team is looking into it and an announcement will be made when this issue is resolved.

[b]4. Controller issues[/b]
Playstation 3, Playstation 4 and Xbox 360 controllers should be working correctly. However, we are aware that Xbox One controllers may have issues and are working on a fix. Please note that having controllers plugged in may conflict with mouse input .

[b]Possible fix for Xbox One Controllers[/b] : Replacing the Xinput driver from the KB3140743 update with a previous version of the driver should fix the problem. (Thank you to the user that brought this to our attention)

[b]5. Server bottleneck issues[/b]
The server bottleneck problem seems to be much worse than expected. We are currently looking into several options to mitigate the problem, including creating a new server. We have not yet reached a final decision on the details and will let you know as soon as possible.

[b]6. Spamming on chat[/b]
You will be able to reset the chat and get rid of spamming of messages in chat by restarting your client. Please let us know if the problems persists after restarting the client. We are looking at ways to reduce spam and will make an announcement when it is implemented.

[b]7. QUEST : To Gateway to the Great King[/b]
We are aware that there are issues with this quest and are working on a solution. Apologies for the inconvenience that this is causing. In the meantime, we recommend trying to go to Orsha and completing quests in that area for those players that find no other quests for that level.

[b]8. Launcher closes without client properly appearing[/b]
There seems to be a problem with the launcher vanishing without properly launching the client even after validating / re-installing / replacing XML files. The dev team is looking into this matter, but in the meantime, adding "Client_tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release" and "tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release\patch" to the exception list of any Anti-virus programs may help.

[b]9. QUEST :  Obversion / Drowsy Scent[/b]
We are aware that these quests currently have people stumped. We will be working on a more permanent fix. Please stay tuned for an update regarding these quests. In the meantime, we would recommend trying other zones / questlines.

Unfinished Commision should now work properly. However, please let us know via the ticket system if you are still having trouble with this particular quest.

[b]10. Instance disconnect problems / Malfunctioning elevators & cable cars[/b]
This is do to connection problems with the channel. You should be able to connect to the channel if you choose one with less people. The dev team will be looking into the issue to make it more stable. 

[b]11. Disabling Shout Chat on top of the screen[/b]
We are working on a more permanent fix, but at the moment you may disable the banners at the top of your screen to avoid spam by unwanted individuals. Please go to the small gear icon next to your chat window and uncheck the 'Show Shouts on Top' function to disable shout chat.

[b]12. Steam must be running to play this game. SteamAPInitfailed[/b]
This error may occur if you attempt to run the game directly from the desktop. We recommend that you log onto the Steam client and run the game from your library.

[b]13. Zubeck's Secret Moves Item[/b]
This item gives you 1 stat point upon use. There's a bug where if you use it while in a dungeon, the item gets consumed, but you don't receive your stat point. We're going to look into this issue and find a way to compensate those who did not get their stat point from this item.

[b]14. Cannot patch game / launch game after patch[/b]
We are aware that some players are experiencing problems patching and launching the game at the moment. We are looking into the issue, but in the meantime here is the workaround. Apologies for the inconvenience.

 - Go to [i][b]Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release[/b][/i]
 - Open the [i][b]release.revision.txt[/b][/i] file and edit the number to [i][b]11460[/b][/i]
 - Validate local files through Steam and check to see if the language is set to English.


Please let us know if you are experiencing other problems. When reporting issues, please try to be as detailed as possible so that we can have more information to use in resolving those issues.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Fedimian Server and Consolatory Notice [UPDATED]
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

Thank you for your patience throughout our launch for the past few hours.

We are here to bring you news that our new Femidian server is ready to be opened within the next hour.

Please keep in mind that this is a temporary EU server meant to accommodate players who wish to be transferred to our upcoming server in Europe.

When we open the Femidian server, we will let you know through a new post announcing its release.

Related announcement: https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/temporary-eu-server-in-preparation/157179/


In addition, we would like to make an important announcement regarding the number of players accessing our Exclusive Access servers.

Prior to the announcement, please accept our apologies for rather crowded servers with high traffics.

We had initially planned 2 servers based on our sales data. They were sufficient enough to support the player base without waiting queues.

However, there was an unexpected jump in sales a day prior to our scheduled launch date. There was an additional influx of sales, the amount exceeding well over a third of our most recent total sales, and the statistics were not observed in time due to the data refresh being queued.

As a result, our players experienced heavy lags and connection issues, which is what we previously stated that we would prevent.

In order to make up for the inconvenience we have caused you on the first day of our grand opening due to our inability to foresee this event, we would like to provide you with compensation. We will make a separate announcement later regarding the details.

A great number of mistakes have already been made, but we hope to learn from this and deliver you a stable service and an enjoyable game. We would greatly appreciate your support in this endeavor. Thank you.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

[b][UPDATE - March 29th][/b]
We would like to announce the consolatory items that will be provided via the in-game message box. Please refer to the list below for details. 

- Enchant Scroll x 5
- EXP Tome x 5
- Lv 15 Movement Speed Potion x 20

The items will expire on 11:59 p.m. (EDT) on the 4th of April, 2016 so make sure you claim the items before that time.

notes.title: Founder's Server : Exclusive Access Now Purchasable on Steam
notes.content:
Hello, Saviors!

This is an announcement to let you know that the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access is available for purchase on Steam.

Please note the following
1. Service Schedule
 - Founder's Server Open Date : Tuesday, March 29, 2016 02:00 AM (EST)
 - Free to Play Server Open Date : Thursday, April 28, 2016 (EST)

 2. Purchasing the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access does not directly allow access to the founder's server.

3. We will create more worlds in order to avoid waiting queues by keeping an eye out on the demand shown prior to the March 29th opening.

In addition, please refer to the below for information on how to claim your Founder's Pack in the game.


Information on the Founder's Pack exclusives and TP:

1.The items will be sent to your in-game message box via GM message that will be accessible after Team creation. You may choose which character you wish to give the items to from the GM message.


2.You may only receive the items on one world so please choose carefully.


3.There will be no time limit on when you can redeem your items. You may decide to receive them at the time of your choice.


4.The Hoglan companion is obtainable in-game from Companion Traders for 453,600 Silver. The purchasers of Access Pass 1 will be provided with a Hoglan Voucher that can be exchanged at the Companion Traders.


5.The Hanaming and Popolion Doll Hair Accessories cannot be obtained in-game. They may be obtainable in the future through other products or events.


6.The Stat Reset Potion cannot be obtained in-game, while the Skill Reset Potion can be purchased from the TP shop.


7.Token benefits cannot be paused / restarted once the Token is used. Please make sure you wish to receive the benefits before using Tokens.


8.A maximum of 3 options can be enchanted on the Hair Accessories by purchasing "Magic Scrolls" from the TP shop.


9.TP obtained from the passes can be used to purchase premium items from the TP shops in the cities.


Best regards,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Founder's Server : Exclusive Access Now Purchasable on Steam
notes.content:
Hello, Saviors!

This is an announcement to let you know that the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access is available for purchase on Steam.

Please note the following
1. Service Schedule
 - Founder's Server Open Date : Tuesday, March 29, 2016 02:00 AM (EST)
 - Free to Play Server Open Date : Thursday, April 28, 2016 (EST)

 2. Purchasing the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access does not directly allow access to the founder's server.

3. We will create more worlds in order to avoid waiting queues by keeping an eye out on the demand shown prior to the March 29th opening.

In addition, please refer to the below for information on how to claim your Founder's Pack in the game.


Information on the Founder's Pack exclusives and TP:

1.The items will be sent to your in-game message box via GM message that will be accessible after Team creation. You may choose which character you wish to give the items to from the GM message.


2.You may only receive the items on one world so please choose carefully.


3.There will be no time limit on when you can redeem your items. You may decide to receive them at the time of your choice.


4.The Hoglan companion is obtainable in-game from Companion Traders for 453,600 Silver. The purchasers of Access Pass 1 will be provided with a Hoglan Voucher that can be exchanged at the Companion Traders.


5.The Hanaming and Popolion Doll Hair Accessories cannot be obtained in-game. They may be obtainable in the future through other products or events.


6.The Stat Reset Potion cannot be obtained in-game, while the Skill Reset Potion can be purchased from the TP shop.


7.Token benefits cannot be paused / restarted once the Token is used. Please make sure you wish to receive the benefits before using Tokens.


8.A maximum of 3 options can be enchanted on the Hair Accessories by purchasing "Magic Scrolls" from the TP shop.


9.TP obtained from the passes can be used to purchase premium items from the TP shops in the cities.


Best regards,
IMC Staff
